notes.title: Name change updates and news
notes.content:
I did change the name of the game to RTSM (Real-time strategy mix) from SAWars. My idea first was to create a rts game with South Africa history in mind, this will still be in there ,later a story-driven scenario as well. With the new RTSM will there be more factions to play with for example zombies, sci-fi.
This can create unique and interesting scenarios Zulu's against zombies, troll's and monster against sci-fi 

What will be in the new update

- Recode the engine for better performance 
- Multiplayer Ai coop on PVP
- Fog of war
- lots more factions
- plenty of maps
- Steam awards
